class.name: GamepadBakedMaps
class.brief_description: [InputRouter]'s compiled route map: every binding template in the project, packed.
class.description: The route map holds one compiled template per binding id and scheme, the context table and the response curves, as packed arrays. Every row the router places is copied from a template, so a baked map means no binding is compiled at runtime. The editor bakes this resource on export into [member ProjectSettings.input_devices/router/baked_map]. A file saved at that path in the project is never exported. At runtime the router loads the baked map when it is first enabled; a binding the map lacks, or one whose tuning differs in an editor build, is compiled into a new map at the next frame with a warning. Hand the router a map directly with [method InputRouter.set_route_map]. The data is checked against this build's format version and caps; a map that fails the check is refused.

members.member: The packed route map: format version, caps, schemes, context ids and settings, binding ids, actions, labels, 64-byte rows and curve samples. Written by the baker; not meant to be edited by hand.
